doc.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
doc.interviewee: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor

title: Noone at the Rumbogie while Brown was in New York
summary: The interviewer asks whether Brown was around when Jimmie Noone broadcast from the Rumbogie; Brown was in New York then, in the late 1930s.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Do you remember that Jimmy Newman was at Rumbogie or was that while you were gone?
He broadcast from out there I think, but he had a fairly big band. You had five pieces.
I was in New York. I was in New York. When Rumbogie was open I was in New York. I lived here in 28.
Oh yeah, come to think but it was in the late 30s. Yeah, yeah.
